reserveReview.rationale: Re-fetched the Aster docs on 2026-07-20: asUSDF is the yield-bearing asToken received by staking USDF on Aster Earn, NAV-accreting from the delta-neutral and funding-fee strategies that back USDF, with withdrawals returning USDF after the documented T+1 hour (two-hour) waiting period and no mint or withdrawal fee. The direct reserve is therefore 100% USDF held in the asUSDFEarn wrapper, a wrapper dependency on the tracked usdf-astherus record; the on-chain wrapper path (deposit USDF, mint calculated shares, no free-mint route) was verified at BSC block 110184782 in the 2026-07-15 mint-authority review. Upstream USDF composition (USDT at Ceffu plus Binance/MirrorX delta-neutral deployment) is inherited from the linked record and not duplicated here. Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: mint-asusdf.md states asUSDF is the yield-bearing token received by staking USDF; FAQ still describes USDF minted 1:1 with USDT held at Ceffu and delta-neutral strategies. GitHub asUSDFEarn.sol deposit path remains USDF-in/shares-out. Updated source URL to live docs slug earn/overview/mint-asusdf.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At the asUSDF layer there is no legal custodian or holder-claim structure: deposited USDF sits in the asUSDFEarn wrapper contract, whose admin (a 4-of-8 Safe acting through a six-hour timelock, verified at BSC blocks 110184782/110184820) can upgrade wrapper logic and whose ADMIN_ROLE can pause transfers. Aster documents that upstream USDT is transferred to Aster's Ceffu custodial account and deployed into delta-neutral positions, which is documented asset reuse rather than segregation, hence rehypothecation permitted at the upstream layer; Ceffu account terms, venue-level segregation, bankruptcy treatment, and provider shares are unpublished. asUSDF-to-USDF withdrawal is documented at T+1 hour (two hours); upstream USDF-to-USDT redemption takes 1-2 days standard and up to 7 days for large amounts per the FAQ.
